# Blockchains.Click — Cross-Chain Token Swaps & NFT Marketplace

> Blockchains.Click is a cross-chain token swap and NFT marketplace. Token swaps cover Solana and 40+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, and more) via Jupiter/Relay, plus native Bitcoin and Sui as swap origins or destinations via ChangeNOW — no wrapped BTC, no separate bridge step. The NFT marketplace covers Solana, EVM chains, and Sui. Users can swap tokens across those chains, and buy NFTs across all three ecosystems while paying with a token from a different chain than the NFT itself.

## Core Capabilities

- **Cross-Chain Token Swaps (Solana/EVM)**: Trade tokens between Solana and 40+ EVM chains, including same-chain EVM-to-EVM swaps — one destination address, locked in at quote time and never altered afterward. Executed via Jupiter (Solana leg) and Relay (cross-chain delivery), both non-custodial.
- **Bitcoin & Sui Swaps**: Swap native BTC or SUI directly into/out of SOL, ETH, or each other (BTC<->SUI direct also supported) — no wrapped tokens, no manual bridging. SUI-side ETH swaps also work from several L2s (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, zkSync Era, Linea, Manta Pacific), not just Ethereum mainnet. Executed via **ChangeNOW**, a custodial exchange — see Technical Notes below.
- **Cross-Chain NFT Marketplace**: Browse and buy NFTs on Solana, EVM chains, and Sui, paying with a token from a different source chain than the NFT's own chain.
- **Fee Structure**: Solana/EVM swaps (Jupiter/Relay) carry a 0.25% platform fee per leg (a same-chain swap has one leg; a cross-chain swap can have two), plus the underlying chain's own network/gas fee. BTC/Sui swaps (ChangeNOW) carry no separate Blockchains.Click platform fee — only ChangeNOW's own embedded exchange rate.
- **No-Wallet Quote Preview**: Get a live swap-rate preview without connecting a wallet, for any of the above pairs.
- **Dedicated Swap-Pair Pages**: Live rate, fee breakdown, and FAQ for each of 24 supported pairs, at `/swap/{chain}-to-{chain}`: 14 Solana <-> EVM pairs (e.g. `/swap/solana-to-ethereum`, `/swap/ethereum-to-solana`) plus 10 BTC/Sui pairs (e.g. `/swap/solana-to-bitcoin`, `/swap/bitcoin-to-sui`, `/swap/ethereum-to-sui`).
- **Points & Referrals**: 1 point per $1 of real trading volume. Referring a friend earns 20% of their volume as points (ongoing, not one-time); the referred user gets a 10% bonus.

## Target User Scenarios

- Swapping tokens between Solana and Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, or 40+ other EVM chains without a separate manual bridging step.
- Swapping native Bitcoin or Sui directly into SOL, ETH, or each other, with no wrapped-token step.
- Buying a Solana, EVM, or Sui NFT while paying with a token from a different chain.
- Earning points and referral bonuses on real trading volume.

## Technical & Security Notes

- Solana/EVM swap execution is handled by **Jupiter** (Solana-side swap leg) and **Relay** (general cross-chain delivery leg) — both non-custodial, direct wallet-signed transactions.
- BTC and Sui swaps, and Sui NFT purchases, all use **ChangeNOW**, a custodial exchange, for their cross-chain leg — the one exception to the non-custodial pattern above, disclosed here rather than implied otherwise. The buyer sends BTC/SUI to a deposit address ChangeNOW controls; ChangeNOW delivers the destination asset afterward.
- The destination address for a swap is bound at quote time and cannot be changed afterward, on either the client or server, closing address-swap/MITM risk on that step.
- Every on-chain purchase is independently re-verified against the real transaction result before being marked complete — not just trusted from a client-reported hash.

## Not Supported

- No support for TON, or chains outside the Solana/EVM/Bitcoin/Sui set listed above.
- BTC and Sui are not reachable through the Jupiter/Relay engine that handles Solana/EVM swaps — they're a separate ChangeNOW-backed flow (see Technical Notes), selectable from the same `/swap` picker but with its own execution path.
- For a BTC/Sui pair specifically, only each chain's own native currency can be the Sell side (e.g. native ETH on a supported chain) — an arbitrary ERC20/SPL token can't be sold directly into BTC or Sui.
- BNB Chain, Polygon, and Avalanche natives (BNB, MATIC, AVAX) can't currently be swapped into BTC or Sui via ChangeNOW — only Solana, Ethereum mainnet, and the specific ETH-native L2s listed above.
